messages.landing.bottom.heading: Get started
messages.landing.bottom.premium_note: The bot takes reservations only on premium servers. A new server stays inactive until premium is turned on.
messages.landing.bottom.sub: Add Letter to your Discord server, then sign in to set ranks and channels.
messages.landing.feature.channels.desc: Choose one channel for /book and one for the summary. Anyone who books elsewhere is told where to go.
messages.landing.feature.channels.name: Channels
messages.landing.feature.characters.desc: Level, vocation, guild and last login of every booked character, straight from TibiaData.
messages.landing.feature.characters.name: Characters
messages.landing.feature.reservations.desc: Book a respawn with /book or in the panel. Overlapping bookings are refused, and managers can edit or cancel any reservation.
messages.landing.feature.reservations.name: Reservations
messages.landing.feature.roles.desc: Pick which Discord roles manage respawns, which can book and which may overbook. Server admins always keep full control.
messages.landing.feature.roles.name: Ranks & permissions
messages.landing.feature.stats.desc: Booked hours per respawn and player, and experience per hour from the TibiaData highscores.
messages.landing.feature.stats.name: Stats & experience
messages.landing.feature.summary.desc: A live schedule of upcoming reservations in the channel you pick, refreshed as soon as something changes.
messages.landing.feature.summary.name: Discord summary
messages.landing.features.heading: Everything your respawn schedule needs
messages.landing.features.sub: The bot works in your Discord server, the panel keeps the settings and the numbers. You decide who can book, where and for how long.
messages.landing.hero.sub: Letter handles respawn reservations for your Tibia guild. Members book with /book, the bot keeps a live schedule in your Discord server, and the panel gives you ranks, channels and stats.
messages.landing.meta.description: Letter is a Discord bot and web panel for Tibia respawn reservations: book with /book, see the schedule on Discord, set ranks and channels, and follow stats and experience per respawn and player.
messages.landing.meta.title: Letter: Tibia respawn reservations for your Discord server
messages.landing.tools.heading: Tools that just open. No account.
messages.landing.tools.sub: Split the loot of a hunt between your party in seconds. You need no Discord server and no login.
messages.range.picker.hint_days: Tap a day to add or remove it.
messages.range.picker.hint_range: Tap the first day, then the last day.
